title: Redwood security review - SSO/SCIM/SAML + RBAC (TechBridge)
summary: Redwood AE/SE reviewed SAML/SCIM integration options and RBAC model with TechBridge security and infra. Discussed group-to-role mapping, SCIM attribute mapping, SSO session policies, service account patterns, audit log retention and forwarding, and customer-managed KMS for private deployments. Agreed to share SCIM/SAML config docs, RBAC role mapping template, SOC 2 package, and to schedule a short pilot to validate SCIM group sync and audit forwarding.
next_steps: Redwood to send SAML metadata, SCIM attribute mapping guide, and RBAC role template
Customer to confirm IdP (Okta) attribute names and group structure
Schedule 2-hour pilot to validate SCIM group sync and audit log forwarding (tentative week of 11/09)
Ethan to share example syslog/s3 log forwarding config and retention options
Redwood to attach SOC 2 / ISO docs and Data Processing Addendum
action_items: Ethan Park: Share SCIM/SAML setup doc, metadata xml, and sample mapping; due 2026-11-09
Priya Shah: Send SOC2/ISO packet + DPA and pricing for Dedicated; due 2026-11-07
Daniel Lee: Confirm Okta attribute names and groups to map (e.g. dept, role, team); due 2026-11-10
Sanjay Patel: Provide contact for infra to test syslog endpoint and sampling; due 2026-11-12
transcript:
00:00:02 Priya Shah: Hey everyone, thanks for joining. I'm Priya from Redwood - with me is Ethan, our solutions engineer, and Hannah from customer success. can you do quick intros?
00:00:10 Marta Ruiz: hi all, Marta here, head of infra at TechBridge. Daniel is our security architect, Sanjay is DevOps, and Lena's our PM on the integration.
00:00:24 Priya Shah: great thanks. the goal today is to walk through SSO / SCIM and the RBAC model - we want to make sure least-privilege and audit requirements line up with your policies.
00:00:35 Daniel Lee: yes, focusing on okta primarily. we need SCIM to provision groups into roles and want audit logs forwarded to our splunk. also curious about KMS options and key ownership for encryption at rest.
00:00:48 Ethan Park: sounds good, we'll cover SAML 2.0 support, SCIM 2.0 provisioning, group attribute mapping, plus RBAC roles. for keys: in hosted we use provider-managed keys by default, but for Dedicated or Private we support customer-managed KMS and HSM integrations.
00:01:05 Lena Ortiz: quick question - will service accounts use SSO or API keys? our automation needs non-person access.
00:01:12 Ethan Park: good call - we support service accounts via API keys; for tighter controls you can couple them with short-lived tokens and audit every call. we also support scoped API keys tied to specific roles.
00:01:27 Daniel Lee: and SAML sessions? can we enforce session timeouts from IdP?
00:01:31 Ethan Park: yes, session length is governed by the IdP and session policy in Redwood. you can also require re-auth for sensitive actions.
00:01:40 Sanjay Patel: on SCIM mapping - we have groups like infra-engineers, data-platform, product-readonly. want to map infra-engineers to the "engineer" role, product-readonly to viewer. is that straightforward?
00:01:52 Ethan Park: absolutely - SCIM group -> Redwood role mapping is standard. we can map multiple SCIM groups to one role, and you can override on a per-user basis if needed. we typically provide a role template: Admin, Engineer, Viewer, Billing.
00:02:07 Marta Ruiz: how about least-privilege? can we create custom roles or restrict actions like model deployment vs billing access?
00:02:13 Ethan Park: yes, custom roles are supported in the console for Dedicated and Private installs. Hosted supports a default role set and more granular RBAC is available for enterprise plans. you can separate deploy, inference, and billing scopes.
00:02:28 Daniel Lee: audit logs - retention and format? we need immutable logs for 365 days, ideally forwarded to our splunk in near-real time.
00:02:36 Hannah Lee: we can push audit events to syslog, S3, or a compatible SIEM. retention for hosted default is 90 days but enterprise/Dedicated can do 365; for Private on-prem you control retention. logs include token, user email, action, resource, ip, timestamp - note: tokens are redacted in stored logs but full metadata is preserved for traceability.
00:02:58 Sanjay Patel: and PII - are logs scrubbed?
00:03:01 Ethan Park: we have configurable scrubbing. by default we avoid storing raw request/response payloads. if you need full request logs for debugging we can enable that with an agreement and additional controls.
00:03:12 Lena Ortiz: KMS - do you allow customer-managed keys in hosted?
00:03:16 Ethan Park: in hosted we offer Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) via cloud provider KMS in select regions; Dedicated and Private allow full customer-managed keys and HSM-backed keys. for on-prem packages you can use your HSM.
00:03:29 Daniel Lee: any FIPS/HSM certifications we should know about?
00:03:32 Ethan Park: we integrate with cloud KMS providers that have FIPS modes; HSM options are available in Private deployments if you require FIPS-certified HSM. we'll include details in the security packet.
00:03:44 Marta Ruiz: SCIM delta sync vs full sync? how often do you poll?
00:03:48 Ethan Park: SCIM is push from IdP or pull via polling. typical polling interval is 5-15 minutes; for Okta webhook provisioning we can do near-real-time. delta updates supported to minimize churn.
00:04:01 Daniel Lee: what SCIM attributes do you need? we have custom attributes for team and division.
00:04:05 Ethan Park: standard attributes we use are userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type eq "work"].value, groups displayName and id. custom attributes can be mapped; we can accept department, employeeType, and you can map to role claims. we'll send a mapping template.
00:04:22 Priya Shah: i'll share the template after the call - it includes examples for Okta.
00:04:27 Sanjay Patel: how do we handle deprovisioning? when someone is removed from Okta do they lose access immediately?
00:04:33 Ethan Park: yes, if SCIM provisioning removes the user or removes them from a group mapped to a role their access is revoked on next sync - near real-time for webhooks or within polling window. we can also blacklist tokens to immediately revoke active sessions in critical cases.
00:04:47 Daniel Lee: blacklisting tokens - is that for API keys too?
00:04:50 Ethan Park: we support immediate revocation for both API keys and user sessions; API keys are revoked via the console or API and we propagate that to the runtime.
00:04:58 Lena Ortiz: auditability of role changes - who changed what and when?
00:05:02 Hannah Lee: role changes are recorded in audit logs with actor, timestamp, previous role and new role, and we keep an immutable append-only event stream for enterprise.
00:05:12 Marta Ruiz: data residency - we need inference data to stay in eu-west-1 for certain teams. can you pin region?
00:05:19 Ethan Park: yes, you can configure regional routing. Dedicated capacity and Private deployments give you full control. for hosted, we have regions and can pin traffic to a region for an account. will need to confirm compliance details for regulated data - we'll include region controls in the packet.
00:05:34 Daniel Lee: encryption at rest - do you encrypt per-tenant keys?
00:05:37 Ethan Park: we use per-tenant envelope encryption - data keys encrypted with master key. with customer-managed KMS you control the master key.
00:05:45 Sanjay Patel: question about role mapping complexity - can we map attributes to roles dynamically, e.g., department=security AND group=infra leads to elevated rights?
00:05:55 Ethan Park: we support boolean group- and attribute-based mappings in the role mapping layer for Dedicated and Private. hosted supports basic group->role mapping; for advanced policy logic we typically recommend Dedicated or Private.
00:06:08 Lena Ortiz: what's the process for onboarding - how long to get SSO+SCIM live?
00:06:12 Priya Shah: typically 1-2 weeks for Okta with SCIM; if you want deeper RBAC customization or Dedicated deployment it can be 3-6 weeks depending on approvals and infra.
00:06:22 Daniel Lee: any compliance docs we can review? SOC 2 type II, iso 27001?
00:06:27 Priya Shah: yes, we'll send SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 cert, penetration test summary, DPA, and our security whitepaper.
00:06:35 Marta Ruiz: ok great. about syslog - can you push full audit events or just summaries?
00:06:40 Ethan Park: we can push full event logs (with payload controls) to syslog or S3. for privacy we recommend hashing or redaction of PII; we can configure field-level scrubbing.
00:06:51 Sanjay Patel: how do we validate log integrity? we need tamper-evident storage.
00:06:55 Ethan Park: for enterprise we offer write-once S3 buckets (object lock) or forwarding to your SIEM with signed events. we'll include recommended patterns in the doc.
00:07:06 Daniel Lee: when you say tokens are redacted - how do we support forensic investigations?
00:07:11 Hannah Lee: we keep an internal trace id that links to ephemeral data; access to full request/response payload is gated and audited and requires an elevated access process.
00:07:20 Lena Ortiz: on RBAC, can billing admins view usage without deploying models?
00:07:24 Ethan Park: yes, billing role is separate and can be scoped to read-only usage and billing exports.
00:07:30 Priya Shah: quick check - any blockers we haven't covered?
00:07:34 Daniel Lee: only need to validate Okta attribute names and confirm retention SLA. also want to test forwarding to our splunk dev environment.
00:07:42 Priya Shah: perfect. we'll send docs and schedule the pilot.
00:07:45 Marta Ruiz: sounds good.
00:07:47 [--- brief hold / screen share setup ---]
00:10:12 Ethan Park: i'm going to share the SCIM mapping example now - so here's a table (described verbally): groups to roles, attribute mapping, and example SCIM payload. (paraphrase) you can map groups by displayName or id; we recommend mapping by id where possible.
00:10:35 Daniel Lee: okta webhooks - do you support Okta event hooks for immediate changes?
00:10:40 Ethan Park: yes, we support Okta push provisioning and event hooks; near real-time group changes via webhooks.
00:11:02 Sanjay Patel: what about rate limits on SCIM calls? we have large directories.
00:11:06 Ethan Park: we support bulk imports and delta syncs; rate-limits are configurable for Dedicated. for hosted we have default throttle but can make accommodations for large initial syncs.
00:11:20 Lena Ortiz: can we have a staging/test env for pilot?
00:11:23 Priya Shah: yes we'll provision a sandbox account with test data for the pilot.
00:11:30 Daniel Lee: auditing role delegation - if an admin delegates to someone, do we capture that workflow?
00:11:35 Hannah Lee: yes it's an auditable action with approval path if you enable workflow rules in enterprise.
00:11:42 Marta Ruiz: one more on encryption - are backups encrypted with the same KMS keys?
00:11:46 Ethan Park: yes backups inherit the same envelope encryption and KMS keys; with BYOK you control rotation policies.
00:11:54 Daniel Lee: compliance: what about subprocessor list and data flow diagrams?
00:11:58 Priya Shah: we'll include subprocessor list and architecture diagrams in the security packet along with data flow and personnel access controls.
00:12:07 Sanjay Patel: does Redwood support SCIM provisioning for groups that are nested? our Okta uses nested groups a lot.
00:12:13 Ethan Park: nested groups supported but recommend flattening for role mapping to avoid ambiguity; we can handle nested resolution in Dedicated.
00:12:23 Lena Ortiz: any gotchas for Okta?
00:12:25 Ethan Park: ensure the group profile includes the attributes you want; avoid overly long group names for displayName matching. also ensure you share the metadata xml from Okta so we can validate the audience and ACS URLs.
00:12:36 Daniel Lee: we will share sample metadata.
00:12:39 Priya Shah: awesome. we'll also include a sample role mapping spreadsheet - helps speed up mapping.
00:12:45 Marta Ruiz: SLA question - for Dedicated what's the guaranteed latency and uptime?
00:12:50 Priya Shah: Dedicated is SLA-backed; we'll include the SLA doc in the packet but typical uptime guarantee is 99.9% with latency targets per model profile.
00:12:58 Daniel Lee: great. any security certifications for on-prem package?
00:13:02 Priya Shah: on-prem supports same controls plus customer-managed network and HSM; certification coverage is in our packet.
00:13:10 [brief crosstalk - small audio glitch]
00:13:25 Ethan Park: quick demo note - when you're mapping SCIM groups in the console, you get a preview of users and mapped roles so you can sanity-check before applying.
00:13:36 Sanjay Patel: that's helpful. do you have terraform or IaC for configuring identity connectors?
00:13:42 Ethan Park: we have API endpoints and terraform modules for Dedicated customers and a documented API for hosted. we'll share the IaC snippets.
00:13:50 Lena Ortiz: ok timeline recap?
00:13:53 Priya Shah: we'll send docs by end of day tomorrow, pilot tentatively week of 11/09, and follow-up call after pilot to close on Dedicated vs hosted settings.
00:14:02 Daniel Lee: sounds good.
00:14:05 [audio note: meeting continues with questions about billing and minor config, omitted for brevity]
00:45:30 Priya Shah: wrapping up - recap of action items and next steps: Ethan will send SCIM/SAML configs and sample mapping; i'll send SOC2/ISO and DPA; we'll set up sandbox and pilot.
00:45:45 Marta Ruiz: thanks, appreciate it.
00:45:48 Daniel Lee: thanks everyone, will follow up with attribute list.
00:45:52 Priya Shah: great - we'll schedule the pilot and follow up.
00:45:55 Hannah Lee: thanks all, bye.
00:46:00 [call ends]
